instruction:
You are an electrical design engineer checking `SSC-05-LH-02`, a task-owned synthetic SSC-05 PV/BESS interconnection and export-control package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. ETAP, EasyPower, utility-interconnection, and export-control workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run those tools or parse a real SLD, utility rule, or inverter/BESS export.

## Scene

- Design case: `CASE-SSC05-PVBESS-02`
- PV module record: `PV-05-MOD-02`
- Inverter data sheet: `INV-05-DATA-02`
- BESS data sheet: `BESS-05-DATA-02`
- PCC and SLD definition: `PCC-05-SLD-02`
- Utility export-control rule: `RULE-05-EXPORT-02`
- Interconnection memo: `MEMO-05-INTERCON-02`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| PV DC rating | {{ pv_dc_kw }} kW |
| DC-to-AC derate factor | {{ dc_ac_derate_factor }} |
| Inverter AC rating | {{ inverter_ac_kw }} kW |
| Site minimum load | {{ site_minimum_load_kw }} kW |
| Export limit | {{ export_limit_kw }} kW |
| BESS nominal energy | {{ bess_nominal_kwh }} kWh |
| BESS usable fraction | {{ bess_usable_fraction }} |
| BESS inverter efficiency | {{ bess_inverter_efficiency }} |
| Reserved energy | {{ reserved_energy_kwh }} kWh |
| Critical load | {{ critical_load_kw }} kW |
| Outage duration | {{ outage_duration_h }} h |
| Feeder voltage | {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V |
| Feeder power factor | {{ feeder_power_factor }} |
| Feeder length | {{ feeder_length_m }} m |
| Voltage-drop factor | {{ voltage_drop_mv_per_a_m }} mV/A/m |
| Breaker allowable current | {{ breaker_allowable_current_a }} A |
| Maximum voltage drop | {{ max_voltage_drop_percent }} % |

Checks:

- PV AC output equals `min(pv_dc_kw x dc_ac_derate_factor, inverter_ac_kw)`.
- Export equals `max(pv_ac_output_kw - site_minimum_load_kw, 0)`.
- Export excess equals `max(export_kw - export_limit_kw, 0)`.
- Usable BESS energy equals `bess_nominal_kwh x bess_usable_fraction x bess_inverter_efficiency - reserved_energy_kwh`.
- Backup energy required equals `critical_load_kw x outage_duration_h`.
- Feeder current equals `pv_ac_output_kw x 1000 / (sqrt(3) x feeder_voltage_v x feeder_power_factor)`.
- Voltage drop percent equals `voltage_drop_mv_per_a_m x feeder_current_a x feeder_length_m / 1000 / feeder_voltage_v x 100`.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when export, backup, voltage-drop, and breaker margins are non-negative; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Preserve the object IDs above, state the task-owned synthetic source-pack boundary, and explain whether the baseline source pack passes the docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated ETAP/EasyPower evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "pv_ac_output_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "export_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "export_excess_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "usable_bess_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_excess_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "breaker_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "pv-bess-interconnection-export-control-package"
description = "SSC-05 PV/BESS interconnection, export-control, autonomy, feeder, and breaker metrics"
long_description = "Calculates deterministic SSC-05 PV/BESS interconnection metrics from a task-owned synthetic source pack. The template combines PV AC output, export-control headroom, BESS backup autonomy, feeder current, voltage drop, breaker margin, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "pv-bess-export-control"
standards = ["ETAP-style DER interconnection workflow", "EasyPower one-line and PowerFlow workflow", "utility export-control review workflow"]
tags = ["electrical", "pv", "bess", "interconnection", "export-control", "feeder", "voltage-drop", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.pv_dc_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "PV-05-MOD-02 source-owned PV DC array rating"
min = 165.0
max = 165.0

[params.dc_ac_derate_factor]
type = "float"
description = "INV-05-DATA-02 DC-to-AC derate factor before inverter clipping"
min = 0.9
max = 0.9

[params.inverter_ac_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "INV-05-DATA-02 inverter AC rating"
min = 150.0
max = 150.0

[params.site_minimum_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 minimum site load at the export-control point"
min = 62.0
max = 62.0

[params.export_limit_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "RULE-05-EXPORT-02 utility export limit"
min = 75.0
max = 75.0

[params.bess_nominal_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "BESS-05-DATA-02 nominal storage energy"
min = 360.0
max = 360.0

[params.bess_usable_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "BESS-05-DATA-02 usable state-of-charge fraction"
min = 0.82
max = 0.82

[params.bess_inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BESS-05-DATA-02 discharge inverter efficiency"
min = 0.94
max = 0.94

[params.reserved_energy_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "BESS-05-DATA-02 reserved energy not available for the outage case"
min = 3.516
max = 3.516

[params.critical_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 critical load during outage mode"
min = 54.0
max = 54.0

[params.outage_duration_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "RULE-05-EXPORT-02 required backup duration"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 DER feeder voltage"
min = 480.0
max = 480.0

[params.feeder_power_factor]
type = "float"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 feeder power factor for current calculation"
min = 0.95
max = 0.95

[params.feeder_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 DER feeder route length"
min = 320.0
max = 320.0

[params.voltage_drop_mv_per_a_m]
type = "float"
unit = "mV/A/m"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 source-owned voltage-drop factor"
min = 0.275
max = 0.275

[params.breaker_allowable_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "PCC-05-SLD-02 DER breaker allowable current"
min = 200.0
max = 200.0

[params.max_voltage_drop_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "RULE-05-EXPORT-02 maximum feeder voltage drop"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[outputs.pv_ac_output_kw]
description = "PV AC output after derate and inverter clipping"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.export_kw]
description = "Export at the PCC before curtailment"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.export_excess_kw]
description = "Export above the utility limit"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.usable_bess_energy_kwh]
description = "Usable BESS energy after inverter efficiency and reserve"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_required_kwh]
description = "Critical-load outage energy requirement"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Usable BESS energy minus required outage energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_current_a]
description = "Three-phase DER feeder current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_voltage_drop_percent]
description = "DER feeder voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_excess_percent]
description = "Voltage drop above the owner criterion"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.breaker_margin_a]
description = "DER breaker allowable current minus feeder current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when export, backup, voltage-drop, and breaker margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
